subject: [PATCH v5 15/15] selftests/nfsd: check that listener removal asks rpcbind once

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the NFS daemon selftest suite. The test checks that when a listener is removed, rpcbind is only asked once to unregister it, rather than once for each listener removed. This ensures that removing multiple listeners does not result in multiple timeouts due to repeated requests to rpcbind.
